subject.title: WhatsApp: Add support for querying message reactions

question: Should WhatsApp reactions first be exposed as passive plugin-hook events only, or should the bundled plugin also provide durable historical queries and agent-visible events in the same product direction?
rationale: The issue combines three distinct behaviors—passive observation, historical storage/querying, and agent-session input—with different persistence and routing consequences; source evidence does not establish a pre-approved single contract.

options.title: Ship passive hooks first
options.body: Add correctly scoped add/remove reaction events for plugins without creating agent turns or promising history queries, then evaluate storage separately.

options.title: Define full read model
options.body: Specify storage ownership, retention, query semantics, and opt-in routing before implementing a reaction-history action.

options.title: Keep outbound-only behavior
options.body: Decline inbound and query support for now, leaving reactions as a send-only channel capability.

recommendation.title: Ship passive hooks first
recommendation.body: Add correctly scoped add/remove reaction events for plugins without creating agent turns or promising history queries, then evaluate storage separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Current WhatsApp action and inbound-path history make this person the strongest available owner candidate for choosing the channel contract.
